gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away

definitions.gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away; to clean by wiping
definitions.explanation: To remove dirt, liquid, or other substances from a surface by wiping with a cloth or tissue.

examples.japanese: テーブルの{汚|よご}れを{拭|ふ}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: I wiped the dirt off the table.

examples.japanese: {濡|ぬ}れたタオルで{床|ゆか}の{汚|よご}れを{拭|ふ}き{取|と}ってください。
examples.english: Please wipe the dirt off the floor with a wet towel.

notes: A compound verb formed from {拭|ふ}く (to wipe) and {取|と}る (to take/remove). Emphasizes the removal aspect of wiping, unlike {拭|ふ}く alone which simply means to wipe. Transitive verb; the intransitive counterpart does not exist. Collocations: {汗|あせ}を{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る (wipe off sweat), {涙|なみだ}を{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る (wipe away tears), {汚|よご}れを{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る (wipe off dirt).
